description:
This app reads the NFC chip in Sonicare brush heads
and shows the amount of time this head has been used
as well as the intended lifespan. It also generates
the NFC password from the UID and MFG code and allows
to reset the usage counter.
name: Sonicare Head ID
short_description: Philips Sonicare brush head NFC reader and resetter
